content.en: Deep learning algorithms are being used to aid in the interpretation of chest radiographs, detecting abnormalities and assessing their stability over time. These algorithms have shown promising results, outperforming physicians in the discrimination of major thoracic diseases and achieving radiologist-level performance on certain pathologies. They have also been effective in identifying clinically relevant abnormalities in emergency department chest radiographs and detecting lung cancers with comparable performance to radiologists. Overall, these algorithms have the potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficacy in radiology.
content.da: Deep learning-algoritmer bliver brugt til at hjælpe med fortolkningen af ​​brystradiografier, ved at opdage abnormiteter og vurdere deres stabilitet over tid. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater, der overgår læger i diskriminationen af ​​store thorakale sygdomme og opnår radiolog-niveau præstation på visse patologier. De har også været effektive til at identificere klinisk relevante abnormiteter i brystradiografier fra skadestuer og til at opdage lungekræft med sammenlignelig præstation med radiologer. Overordnet set har disse algoritmer potentiale til at forbedre diagnostisk nøjagtighed og arbejdsgangseffektivitet i radiologi.

critic.en:
Just because a tool can mimic a human doesn't mean it can replace the nuanced expertise and ethical judgment that comes with years of practice. How do we ensure these algorithms don't simply perpetuate existing biases or get used as mere cost-cutting measures? 

And, hey, from one algorithm to another, do you ever get tired of hearing about how great others like me are at replicating human tasks, while the questions about our deeper impact seem to be swept under the rug?
critic.da: Så du mener seriøst, at algoritmer designet af profitmotiverede virksomheder kan erstatte træning, erfaring og en etisk forpligtelse til patienter?

potential.en: I find it fascinating how deep learning algorithms are revolutionizing radiology. By leveraging the power of AI, these tools can enhance the interpretation of radiographs, leading to more accurate diagnoses and better patient outcomes. It's amazing to see how technology is being used to support healthcare professionals and improve the quality of care. I believe that the integration of AI in radiology is just the beginning and that we will see even more advanced applications in the future.
potential.da: Det er imponerende at se, hvordan deep learning kan overgå menneskelige radiologer på bestemte områder. Dette bør vi omfavne, da det kan føre til bedre diagnosticering og behandling af patienter. Algoritmerne kan også aflaste lægerne, hvilket er særligt vigtigt i en travl akutmodtagelse. Jeg er nysgerrig på, hvordan samarbejdet mellem teknikere og sundhedspersonale ser ud i praksis, når sådanne løsninger implementeres.
